rules.name: procedural-sentence-length
rules.message: Procedural sentence exceeds {max} words.

rules.name: descriptive-sentence-length
rules.message: Descriptive sentence exceeds {max} words.

rules.name: compound-instruction
rules.message: Split this compound instruction into separate steps.

rules.name: one-main-idea

params.reason: One main idea per sentence requires judgment.

rules.message: Use one main idea per sentence.

rules.name: active-voice
rules.message: Possible passive voice; use active voice.

rules.name: present-tense
rules.message: Possible past tense in an instruction or list item.

rules.name: command-verb-start
rules.message: Start the instruction with a command verb.

rules.name: missing-article
rules.message: Possible missing article before a noun phrase.

rules.name: noun-as-verb

params.reason: Detecting nouns used as verbs needs a domain noun list.

rules.message: Do not use a noun as a verb.

rules.name: gerund-start
rules.message: Do not start an instruction with a gerund.

rules.name: synonym-pair
rules.message: Use one word consistently; avoid synonym pairs.

rules.name: one-meaning
rules.message: Use this approved word with only its allowed meaning.

rules.name: banned-word
rules.message: Use an approved replacement from the dictionary.

rules.name: technical-terms

params.reason: Technical terms require a future --terms input.

rules.message: Define and use approved technical terms consistently.

rules.name: one-topic-per-paragraph

params.reason: Topic boundaries and topic sentences require judgment.

rules.message: Use one topic per paragraph and put the topic sentence first.

rules.name: procedural-paragraph-length
rules.message: Procedural paragraph exceeds {max} sentences.

rules.name: list-required
rules.message: Use a vertical list for {min_steps} or more steps, parts, or conditions.

rules.name: warning-block
rules.message: Put each warning or caution in its own block before the affected step; placement detection is heuristic.

rules.name: hedge
rules.message: Remove the hedge or state the actual uncertainty.

rules.name: second-person
rules.message: Write to the reader; use 'you' for the person who does the task.

rules.name: facts-preserved
rules.message: Comparison text changed a protected fact.
